title: Landscaping Estimate Checklist
subtitle: Residential Landscaping Estimate: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Landscaping Estimate Checklist covers lawn, bed, tree, shrub, hardscape edge, irrigation zone, and requested improvement. The landscape estimate coordinator records Residential Landscaping Estimate criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Landscaping Estimate Checklist keeps Residential Landscaping Estimate exceptions visible until the landscape estimate coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Landscaping Estimate Checklist at residential property, yard zone, access route, slope, and property edge. Document lawn, bed, tree, shrub, hardscape edge, irrigation zone, and requested improvement identity before Residential Landscaping Estimate begins. Compare lawn, bed, tree, shrub, hardscape edge, irrigation zone, and requested improvement findings with stated Residential Landscaping Estimate criteria; route unresolved Residential Landscaping Estimate issues to landscape operations reviewer.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Residential Landscaping Estimate, identify responsible parties, residential property, yard zone, access route, slope, and property edge, and the linked lawn, bed, tree, shrub, hardscape edge, irrigation zone, and requested improvement source.

fields.label: Zone, plant, irrigation, or feature identifier
Requested outcome, maintenance level, and timing constraint

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Landscaping Estimate facts for lawn, bed, tree, shrub, hardscape edge, irrigation zone, and requested improvement; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Residential Landscaping Estimate inspection checks
items: Plant and turf condition by zone
Sun, drainage, soil, slope, and irrigation context
Access, staging, gate, utility-mark, and property-line constraint
Quantity, area, length, or count basis

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Use observed Residential Landscaping Estimate evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Landscape Estimate Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Property boundary or utility location uncertain
Unsafe tree, slope, access, or equipment condition
Scope conflicts with drainage or neighboring property
Option, exclusion, and customer decision record
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Landscaping Estimate when a boundary, utility, access, tree, slope, chemical, or drainage concern remains. Retain the available Residential Landscaping Estimate proof and route unresolved lawn, bed, tree, shrub, hardscape edge, irrigation zone, and requested improvement scope to landscape estimate coordinator.
